name: Splits
justification: Cute counting observation compresses to a one-liner; statement needs a careful read of the weight definition.
solution_sketch: Weights achievable are 1..floor(n/2) (first element k repeated twice or more adjusts) plus weight n via all-ones; answer is n//2 + 1: for each w <= n/2 use w copies of some value >= 2 padded with 1s, plus the all-ones split of weight n.
